name: Line chart (pgfplots)
description: A line chart drawn natively in LaTeX: two data series and a function, with a grid and legend.
notes: Always set `\pgfplotsset{compat=...}` or you'll get old, ugly defaults and a warning.
Plot a CSV directly: `\addplot table [x=epoch, y=loss, col sep=comma] {data.csv};`
Fonts match your document automatically, which a matplotlib PNG never does.
Lots of points making it slow? Export from matplotlib with `tikzplotlib`, or use `external` to cache.
